title: Agora: Enhancing LLM Agent Reasoning Via Auction-Based Task Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2607.09600v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents requires effective orchestration of diverse expert models and tools. However, existing frameworks typically call APIs, based on coarse-grained matching between tasks and the functions of expert models or tools, while overlooking critical factors such as performance variability and cost efficiency among functionally similar alternatives. To address this, we propose Agora, a framework that uses a confidence-calibrated auction to dynamically allocate tasks to expert models and tools. By treating reasoning steps as tradeable items, Agora bases allocation on calibrated competence rather than raw confidence. Across five main benchmarks, Agora improves or remains competitive with single-model, routing, and cascade baselines under matched candidate pools.

translated_title: Agora：通过基于拍卖的任务分配增强LLM智能体推理能力
translated_abstract: 增强大语言模型（LLM）智能体的推理能力需要对多样化的专家模型和工具进行有效编排。然而，现有框架通常基于任务与专家模型或工具功能之间的粗粒度匹配来调用API，而忽视了功能相似的备选方案之间的性能波动性和成本效率等关键因素。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Agora，一个利用置信度校准拍卖机制将任务动态分配给专家模型和工具的框架。通过将推理步骤视为可交易的项目，Agora基于校准后的能力而非原始置信度来进行分配。在五个主要基准测试中，在匹配的候选池条件下，Agora相较于单模型、路由和级联基线方法均有所提升或保持竞争力。
tldr: 提出Agora框架，通过置信度校准拍卖机制将推理步骤视为可交易项目，基于校准能力而非原始置信度动态地将任务分配给专家模型和工具，在五个基准测试中优于或持平于单模型、路由和级联等基线方法。
en_tdlr: Agora is a framework that treats reasoning steps as tradeable items and uses confidence-calibrated auctions to dynamically allocate tasks to expert models and tools based on calibrated competence rather than raw confidence, improving upon or remaining competitive with single-model, routing, and cascade baselines across five main benchmarks.
